evidence: Natural controls differ by F98Y while backbone RMSD is ~0.6 A; Tyr OH is ~52 A2 exposed
design_consequence: Flat interfaces are likely to accept both residues
minimum_mitigation: Require a tight hydrophobic F98 pocket and reject every candidate that tolerates Y98

evidence: Phase 1.5 found human TRAV21/TRBV9 structures 8CX4 VGTYSTDTQ and 9PBG/9PBH PATYSTDTQ with local RMSD 0.433-0.512 A vs AS4.2
design_consequence: A family-directed binder may also recognize nearby human clonotypes outside the intended boundary
minimum_mitigation: Treat 8CX4 9PBG and 9PBH as mandatory negative or explicitly redefine them as intended positives before design

evidence: A 12 A footprint still contains ~41-44% non-core surface and several exposed germline residues
design_consequence: Binder may label many unrelated T cells using the same V genes
minimum_mitigation: Require >=3 direct CDR3beta contacts and screen same-V-gene unrelated-CDR3 controls

evidence: Multiple disease-associated clonotypes carry Y/FSTDTQ and share highly similar structural solutions
design_consequence: A binder may recognize AS4.1 AS3.1 AS4.3 or other family members
minimum_mitigation: Fix the intended product profile before design; treat family members as negatives for strict AS4.2

evidence: No broad healthy/disease repertoire structural screen has yet been performed
design_consequence: Rare unrelated TCRs may reproduce the local chemical patch
minimum_mitigation: Sequence search followed by structure prediction of nearest patch-level matches

evidence: Only ~37-41% of motif SASA remains exposed in the solved bound complexes
design_consequence: Binder may fail on engaged TCR or compete with pMHC
minimum_mitigation: Define whether free or engaged TCR is the target and test both states

evidence: Two AS4.2 crystal states are consistent but do not sample free membrane TCR dynamics
design_consequence: Pocket geometry may fluctuate beyond the observed ~0.5 A
minimum_mitigation: "Use an ensemble/minimization screen before experimental nomination"

evidence: TRAV21 is recurrent but CDR3alpha sequences vary; the footprint includes ~15-20% alpha-chain surface
design_consequence: Alpha contacts can improve clone specificity but reduce family coverage
minimum_mitigation: Score alpha-chain contacts separately and include alternate-alpha negatives

evidence: Structures are pMHC-bound crystals and omit the full membrane/CD3 context
design_consequence: Accessibility or approach angle may differ on cells
minimum_mitigation: Check membrane-compatible approach and validate on cell-surface TCR experimentally

evidence: SASA and geometry do not measure binding free energy specificity or safety
design_consequence: Computational selectivity may not reproduce experimentally
minimum_mitigation: Require biophysical binding and cell-panel testing before any therapeutic interpretation
